title: Query envelope
description: Request body of every query subject (`oe.v1.{service}.query.…`), sent with NATS request/reply. Queries have no side effects and create no operation. Service schemas narrow `params` with `allOf`.

params.description: Typed filters, selectors and pagination. `{}` when the query takes none.

headers.description: NATS headers a query may carry: the sender's trace context.
